title.english: The Voice That Calls a Stop

pairs.target: dìèrtiān , wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu xiān kāi liànxí guì .
pairs.english: The next day, Instructor Vey did not open the practice cabinet first.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天，维老师没有先开练习柜。

pairs.target: tā kàn wán tǎ wéi dàilái de liǎngzhāng tú , bǎ mǐlā nà zhāng dāndú fàngzài zhuō jiǎo , wèn zhè shì shuí ràng tā nálái de .
pairs.english: Having examined the two drawings Tavi brought, she placed Mira's sheet separately at the table corner and asked who had authorised him to bring it.
pairs.hanzi: 她看完塔维带来的两张图，把米拉那张单独放在桌角，问这是谁让他拿来的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōmíng jīngguò , tā biàn jiào tā bǎ tú fān dào bèimiàn , bié ràng zhuōshàng de tiěxiè zhān shàngqù .
pairs.english: Tavi explained, so she told him to turn the drawing face down, keeping the iron filings on the table from sticking to it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说明经过，她便叫他把图翻到背面，别让桌上的铁屑沾上去。

pairs.target: zhìyú yú shīfu de jiāzi , tā zhǐ kàn le jǐyǎn , jiù wèn tā jì bu jìde jiāohuàn shì shénme shíhòu tíng de .
pairs.english: As for Master Yu's clamp, she glanced over it only briefly, then asked whether he remembered when the exchange had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 至于虞师傅的夹子，她只看了几眼，就问他记不记得交换是什么时候停的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐzhe zìjǐ tiān dà de luógǎn , shuō suǒhǎo zhīhòu , chè shǒu zhīqián .
pairs.english: Tavi pointed to the screw he'd redrawn larger and said after locking it, before lifting her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维指着自己添大的螺杆，说锁好之后，撤手之前。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī diǎntóu , yòu wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu mō guò nà liǎngpiàn tiě huáng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey nodded, then asked whether he'd touched those two iron springs.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师点头，又问他有没有摸过那两片铁簧。

pairs.target: tā shuō méiyǒu , tā biàn méiyǒu ràng tā zhào nà zhāng tú qù zhǎo xīn cáiliào .
pairs.english: He said no, so she did not have him find new materials from that drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 他说没有，她便没有让他照那张图去找新材料。

pairs.target: tā kāi guì qǔchū de , réng shì yuánlái nà liǎngjiàn xiǎo tiěliào hé yòng guò de jiājù .
pairs.english: She opened the cabinet and took out the same original pair of small iron pieces and the previously used fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 她开柜取出的，仍是原来那两件小铁料和用过的夹具。

pairs.target: zhuōjiǎo xiān diàn wěn , zhīdiǎn , xiànwèi hé jiēchù chù dōu zhàojiù bǎihǎo , liǎngjiàn wánzhěng tiěliào de tǐjī yě chóngxīn hé guò .
pairs.english: First the table leg was shimmed steady, the supports, stops and contact points all set as before, and the volumes of both complete iron pieces checked again.
pairs.hanzi: 桌脚先垫稳，支点、限位和接触处都照旧摆好，两件完整铁料的体积也重新核过。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ná qīngzài shì le liǎngbiān , jiào tā bǎ yuánxiān de dúshù niàn chūlái .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey tested both sides with a light load and asked him to read out the previous readings.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师拿轻载试了两边，叫他把原先的读数念出来。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān dòng de duōxiē , tā méiyǒu zài bǎ tā shuō chéng zuǒbiān tiānshēng gèng ruǎn , xiān bàochū le liǎngcè bùtóng de lìbì .
pairs.english: The left moved more, but he did not again describe it as the left being naturally softer; first he reported the different lever arms on both sides.
pairs.hanzi: 左边动得多些，他没有再把它说成左边天生更软，先报出了两侧不同的力臂。

pairs.target: " jīntiān háishì zhège fúdù . "
pairs.english: “Today, keep this same magnitude.”
pairs.hanzi: “今天还是这个幅度。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhǐ jiù jìlù , yòu bǎ nà zhī zhuāng luódīng de qiǎndié yí dào zìjǐ shǒubiān .
pairs.english: She pointed to the old record, then moved that shallow dish holding screws to her own side.
pairs.hanzi: 她指指旧记录，又把那只装螺钉的浅碟移到自己手边。

pairs.target: " wǒ lái nǐng , zhōngjiān huì tíng yícì , nǐ kěyǐ suíshí jiàotíng . "
pairs.english: “I will turn it and pause once midway; you may call a stop at any time.”
pairs.hanzi: “我来拧，中间会停一次，你可以随时叫停。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiānzhào tā shuō de kōng yǎn yíbiàn , quèrèn zìjǐ de shǒu búhuì dǎngzhù tā , zài bǎ liǎngshǒu fàngdào shúxī de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi first rehearsed once as she said, checked his hands would not block her, then put both hands in the familiar positions.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先照她说的空演一遍，确认自己的手不会挡住她，再把两手放到熟悉的位置。

pairs.target: nàzhǒng xìxiǎo de qiānyǐn chóngxīn chūxiàn shí , tā jiānbǎng lìkè jǐn le .
pairs.english: When that tiny pull reappeared, his shoulders immediately tightened.
pairs.hanzi: 那种细小的牵引重新出现时，他肩膀立刻紧了。

pairs.target: tā hěn xiǎng ràng dòngzuò xiàng yú shīfu nàyàng gānjìng , lián zhǐjiān bǎizài nǎlǐ dōu bù xiǎnde yóuyù .
pairs.english: He badly wanted movements as clean as Master Yu's, without even seeming hesitant over where to place his fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 他很想让动作像虞师傅那样干净，连指尖摆在哪里都不显得犹豫。

pairs.target: kě tā yì xiǎngzhe biérén huì kànjiàn shénme , yòushǒu biàn bú zìjué dì duō yā le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: But as soon as he thought about what others would see, his right hand then unconsciously pressed a little harder.
pairs.hanzi: 可他一想着别人会看见什么，右手便不自觉地多压了一点。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méi pèng tā de shǒu , zhǐ jiào tā kànkàn zìjǐ zhǐjié de yánsè .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey didn't touch his hand, only told him to look at the colour of his own knuckles.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没碰他的手，只叫他看看自己指节的颜色。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sōngkāi duōyú de lì , méiyǒu chèdiào jiēchù , liǎngbiān de biànhuà réngjiù wéichí zài nà yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi released the excess pressure without breaking contact; the changes on both sides were still maintained at that small amount.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维松开多余的力，没有撤掉接触，两边的变化仍旧维持在那一点。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái zhuǎn luógǎn , zhuǎn dào yuē hǎo de dìfāng tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Only then she turned the screw, reaching the agreed point and stopping.
pairs.hanzi: 她这才转螺杆，转到约好的地方停住。

pairs.target: wūwài yǒurén tuō zhe yìzhī shuǐtǒng jīngguò , tǒng yán kē zài ménkuàng shàng , xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Someone outside dragged a bucket past; its rim knocked the doorframe with a clang.
pairs.hanzi: 屋外有人拖着一只水桶经过，桶沿磕在门框上，响了一声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎnjiǎo dòngledòng , méiyǒu huítóu .
pairs.english: Tavi felt the corner of his eye twitch, but did not turn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维眼角动了动，没有回头。

pairs.target: tā zài děng lǎoshī zài nǐng , què fāxiànzìjǐ xiān zài xīnlǐ tì tā nǐng wán le , lián jiānbǎng dōu wǎngqián nuó .
pairs.english: He was waiting for the instructor to turn again, but found he'd already finished the turn for her in his mind, even his shoulders moved forward too.
pairs.hanzi: 他在等老师再拧，却发现自己先在心里替她拧完了，连肩膀都往前挪。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng tíng . "
pairs.english: “I want to stop.”
pairs.hanzi: “我想停。”

pairs.target: huà shuō chūlái , bǐ tā yùxiǎng de qīng .
pairs.english: The words came out more quietly than he expected.
pairs.hanzi: 话说出来，比他预想的轻。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī lìkè yìng le , shǒu liúzài pǔtōng mù zuò páng , méiyǒu jiào tā gǎnjǐn bǔwán .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey answered immediately, keeping her hand beside the ordinary wooden seat, without telling him to hurry and finish.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师立刻应了，手留在普通木座旁，没有叫他赶紧补完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi réng ànzhe liǎngjiàn tiěliào , xiān bǎ nà diǎn jiāohuàn shōuhuí , liǎngbiān zài qīngzài xià huídào yuányàng .
pairs.english: Still pressing both iron pieces, Tavi first cancelled that small exchange, and both sides returned to normal under the light load.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维仍按着两件铁料，先把那点交换收回，两边在轻载下回到原样。

pairs.target: lǎoshī chóngxīn hé guò dúshù , cái ràng tā chè shǒu , suíhòu xièxià qīngzài .
pairs.english: The instructor checked the readings again, only then let him lift his hands and subsequently removed the light load.
pairs.hanzi: 老师重新核过读数，才让他撤手，随后卸下轻载。

pairs.target: luógǎn méiyǒu suǒ wán , mù zuò biàn yóu tā tuō zhe fàng píng , méi ná bànchéng de jiā gù qù chēng rènhé dōngxī .
pairs.english: The screw wasn't fully locked, so the wooden seat was supported and laid flat by her, without using the unfinished grip to hold anything.
pairs.hanzi: 螺杆没有锁完，木座便由她托着放平，没拿半成的夹固去撑任何东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià lái , kànzhe zìjǐ kōng chū de liǎngshǒu , hūrán yǒudiǎn shīwàng .
pairs.english: Tavi sat down, looked at his freed hands and felt suddenly a little disappointed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下来，看着自己空出的两手，忽然有点失望。

pairs.target: " wǒ zuótiān juéde wǒ kàn dǒng le . "
pairs.english: “Yesterday I thought I understood.”
pairs.hanzi: “我昨天觉得我看懂了。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā kàn dǒng le shénme .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked what he had understood.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他看懂了什么。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō luógǎn wèishénme děi huà dà yìdiǎn , háiyǒu yú shīfu bìng búshì kào yìzhí jièzhe cái bǎ bǎnzi liúzhù .
pairs.english: He thought, then said why the screw needed to be drawn larger, and how Master Yu hadn't kept the board together by borrowing continuously.
pairs.hanzi: 他想了想，说螺杆为什么得画大一点，还有虞师傅并不是靠一直借着才把板子留住。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ kàn dǒng le . "
pairs.english: “Then you did understand.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你看懂了。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐbēi tuī dào tā miànqián , yòu bǎ jìlùzhǐ zhuǎnguò lái , ràng tā xiě tíng zài le nǎ yíbù .
pairs.english: She pushed the water cup toward him, then turned the record sheet and had him write at which step he'd stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 她把水杯推到他面前，又把记录纸转过来，让他写停在了哪一步。

pairs.target: tā xiěxià zìjǐ xiān xiǎngzhe bǎ huó zuò wán , shēntǐ wǎngqián nuó le , què méiyǒu bǎ zhè jù gǎichéng tiěliào bùtīnghuà .
pairs.english: He wrote that he'd thought of finishing the job first and his body had moved forward, without changing that sentence into the iron refusing to obey.
pairs.hanzi: 他写下自己先想着把活做完，身体往前挪了，却没有把这句改成铁料不听话。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kànguò , méi ràng tā mǎshàng zài shì , jiào tā xiūxi wán bǎ yuánliào sònghuí guì lǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey read it, didn't let him try again immediately, and told him to rest before returning the materials to the cabinet.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看过，没让他马上再试，叫他休息完把原料送回柜里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hē le bànbēi shuǐ , yǎnjīng nà diǎn jǐnzhāng mànmàn sàn le , shǒuzhǐ réng néng qīngchǔ gǎnjué bēi bì de liáng .
pairs.english: Tavi drank half a cup of water; the tension in his eyes slowly faded, while his fingers could still clearly feel the coolness of the cup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝了半杯水，眼睛那点紧张慢慢散了，手指仍能清楚感觉杯壁的凉。

pairs.target: mǐlā de tú hái píng fàngzài zhuō jiǎo .
pairs.english: Mira's drawing still lay flat at the table corner.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的图还平放在桌角。

pairs.target: tā shōu hǎo zìjǐ de zhǐ , děng lǎoshī quèrèn yuánliào guīwèi , cái bǎ nà zhāng tú ná qǐlái , zhǔnbèi àn yuē dàihuíqù .
pairs.english: He put away his own paper, waited for the instructor to confirm the materials were back, then picked up that drawing to return it as promised.
pairs.hanzi: 他收好自己的纸，等老师确认原料归位，才把那张图拿起来，准备按约带回去。

pairs.target: zǒu dào ménkǒu , tā yòu huítóu wèn , xiàhuí háishì kěbukěyǐ xiān kōng yǎn .
pairs.english: At the door he turned back to ask again whether he could still rehearse first next time.
pairs.hanzi: 走到门口，他又回头问，下回还是可不可以先空演。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhèng dītóu lǐ luódīng , wényán kàn le tā yìyǎn , shuō dāngrán kěyǐ , bié bǎ zhǔnbèi dàngchéng zhǐxǔ xīnshǒu zuò de shì .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey was sorting screws with her head down; hearing him, she looked at him once and said of course he could: don't treat preparation as something only beginners are allowed to do.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师正低头理螺钉，闻言看了他一眼，说当然可以，别把准备当成只许新手做的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , chūménshí gěi zhèngyào jìnlái de rén ràngkāi le lù , shǒulǐ nà zhāng tú méiyǒu zhé .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, made way at the door for the person coming in, and kept that drawing in his hands unfolded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，出门时给正要进来的人让开了路，手里那张图没有折。
